notes.title: Bug Fixes And New Cards
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

1.In snowy weather, all abnormal status effects on players are doubled" → "In snowy weather, the freezing status effect on players is doubled.
2.Gluttonous zombies no longer retain the Rebirth skill after mutation.

New Random Street Cards:
1.Rotten Flesh: While this card is active, it provides 1 hp to a random zombie each turn until all points are consumed. Players can move to this card to remove it.
2.Abandoned Car: After 10 turns, a random card will spawn.
